## Topics

- String manipulation with stringr: str_detect(), str_extract(), str_replace()
- Regular expressions: character classes, anchors, and quantifiers
- Categorical data with forcats: fct_reorder(), fct_lump(), factor level releveling
- Working with dates and times via lubridate: ymd(), dmy(), intervals, durations
